content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** Section 12 warrants Software conformance to Specifications for one year (and while under Maintenance) — satisfying the fallback software-conformance element — but the Agreement contains no warranty of the Maintenance Services and no warranty remedy. Repair appears only as a maintenance obligation (§10(c), p0077) and the sole refund mechanic is the acceptance-period rejection right (§§7–8), expressly "in lieu of any other remedy" and expired on acceptance. Because two fallback elements fail, I flagged a deviation and inserted one minimal two-sentence addition to §12: a 30-day professional-and-workmanlike Maintenance Services warranty plus a repair/replacement/refund remedy. No general disclaimer exists that would swallow the express warranty, and §15's direct-damages limitation does not conflict with the added remedy.
